bundle.shortDescription: SECS/GEM host and equipment simulator over HSMS (Beta)
bundle.longDescription: Connect to semiconductor and electronics equipment over HSMS as a GEM host: establish communications, read status variables and equipment constants, define reports and watch event reports, alarms, remote commands, process programs and terminal messages, with every message shown as SML. Pro adds a built-in equipment simulator, live trends, constant writes, the report wizard, remote commands, an SML composer, CSV export and unlimited profiles. Independent implementation, not affiliated with SEMI; untested on real equipment.
